raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17) delivered txn_ts as 13-digit epoch milliseconds instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' strings, so the cast to TIMESTAMP fails. Read as UTC, 1768543211000 is 2026-01-16 06:00:11, which fits that batch's business day and the ~06:00 first-transaction pattern seen in the other batches.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH src AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(txn_ts), '[0-9]{13}') THEN make_timestamp(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT) * 1000) WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(txn_ts), '[0-9]{10}') THEN make_timestamp(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT) * 1000000) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS parsed_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, parsed_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(parsed_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM src;"}}
